title: Mad at the Machine
style: Dark club house, 126 BPM, deep driving bassline, punchy four-on-the-floor kick, crisp claps and open hi-hats, sidechained warm synth pads, big filtered build-ups into heavy bass drops, confident sassy female vocal, upfront and clear, nightclub energy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Round one... fight!

[Verse 1]
Up before the sun, you're already mad
Typing "AI's ruining art" on your iPad
Your phone finished your sentence, your feed picked your song
Your car parks itself, but the robots are wrong?

[Pre-Chorus]
Shout it louder, type it in caps
Ask Siri where to post it, then take a lap

[Chorus]
You're mad at the machine (mad, mad)
But you're living on a screen (mad, mad)
Asked a bot to fix your grammar
Then you swung the angry hammer
You're mad at the machine!

[Verse 2]
You said "no soul" with a filter on your face
Smoothed out your skin, now you're from outer space
Your boss got an email that ChatGPT wrote
Then you posted "real humans only" and you gloat

[Pre-Chorus]
Shout it louder, type it in caps
Ask Siri where to post it, then take a lap

[Chorus]
You're mad at the machine (mad, mad)
But you're living on a screen (mad, mad)
Asked a bot to fix your grammar
Then you swung the angry hammer
You're mad at the machine!

[Bridge]
Beep boop, cry about it
Beep boop, post about it
Your toaster's got a better take
Reboot, reboot, for goodness' sake

[Drop]
Mad! Mad! Mad at the machine!

[Outro]
Game over... insert coin
(K.O.!)
